summary: Frontend-only verification of new Text and Logo +/- buttons in /customize preview-controls. All requested behaviors pass: text-size-plus/minus resize preview-print-text (font-size 51.2px -> 74.24px after 3x plus, down to 25.6px at min); slider stays in sync (1.0 -> 1.45 -> capped at 1.9, floored at 0.5). Logo controls appear after image upload and behave identically (width 193.4px -> 287.0px, slider 0.6 -> 0.9 -> capped at 1.2, floored at 0.3, width 93.6px at min). Regression: typing in order-print-text updates preview-print-text ('Hello Coco' rendered); preview-text-block present for dragging; coconut base image renders correctly (real coconut visible in preview screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: Clamp math uses (s +/- 0.15).toFixed(2) which can leave slider value not landing exactly on step=0.05 boundary (e.g., 1.9 exact reached; fine). Non-blocking.
Text step (0.15) differs from slider step (0.05); this is intentional for coarser button jumps but worth documenting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order submit was not exercised in this iteration because iteration_7/8 already verified full order flow at 100%. The +/- buttons for both text and logo are correctly wired to setTextScale/setLogoScale with clamps 0.5-1.9 / 0.3-1.2 respectively, and both slider values sync live. Coconut base image reverted image renders fine (verified via preview screenshot).
